sections.label: TOOL CALL: python
sections.content:
<tool_call>
<function=python>
<parameter=code>
res = action(['RIGHT']*7 + ['UP','UP'])
print('result:', {k: last_action_result.get(k) for k in ('board_changed','gameplay_changed','no_impact','done','level_completed','reward')})
def boxes(frame):
    d={}
    for n in frame.segmentation['nodes']:
        b=n['boundary']; rs=[p[0] for p in b]; cs=[p[1] for p in b]
        d.setdefault(n['color'], []).append((min(rs),max(rs),min(cs),max(cs),n['pixels']))
    return d
before=boxes(previous_frame); after=boxes(current_frame)
for col in sorted(set(list(before)+list(after))):
    if before.get(col)!=after.get(col):
        print(col, 'BEFORE', before.get(col), 'AFTER', after.get(col))
</parameter>
</function>
</tool_call>
